description: A JSON formatter that validates and beautifies instantly — or minifies. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

action.description: 'format' pretty-prints with the indent given; 'minify' strips all whitespace into one line; 'validate' only checks that it parses and returns the text unchanged.

indent.description: Spaces per nesting level when formatting, or 'tab' for one tab per level. 0 gives no indentation. Ignored by minify and validate.

json.description: The JSON text to work on. Invalid JSON comes back as an error naming where parsing failed.

sortKeys.description: Sort object keys alphabetically at every level when formatting, so two documents can be compared. Arrays keep their order. Ignored by minify and validate.

name: json_formatter
title: JSON Formatter
